definition: An open work permit available to some international students after they graduate from a Canadian programme. Eligibility depends on the institution's designation and the field and level of the programme studied, and the rules governing which programmes qualify have been narrowed in recent years.
longform: Because eligibility is tied to the specific programme and institution, it is a decision that has to be checked before enrolling; a genuinely completed Canadian qualification does not automatically carry this entitlement.
